events.title: Brisbane Improv Festival 2026 — Nightly Shows
events.description: Experience five nights of diverse improvised shows from Brisbane's improv community, featuring formats from comedy and musical improv to horror and drama, performed by local and national artists. This festival offers a celebration of spontaneous theatre and storytelling.

events.title: Brisbane Improv Festival 2026 — Workshops
events.description: Participate in over 15 different improv workshops covering skills like storytelling, musical improv, and character development, led by experienced improvisers as part of the Brisbane Improv Festival. Ideal for those looking to expand their creative performance skills.

events.title: Brisbane Open House 2026
events.description: Explore 93 significant buildings across Brisbane, including private homes, commercial towers, and cultural venues, with rare access, guided walks, talks, and concerts. This free event offers insight into Brisbane's architecture, design, and history.

events.title: Make A Scene — Free Exhibition
events.description: Immerse yourself in a free exhibition celebrating 90s Australian queer culture, fashion, and community, coinciding with the 35th anniversary of decriminalisation. Engage with personal stories and Brisbane-based labels that defined the era's underground club scene.

events.title: Sacred & Everyday: Indian Devotional Art
events.datetime: Until 5 October 2026, open daily during the week
events.description: Explore a free exhibition of stunning and rare Indian oleographs from the late 1800s, showcasing how the divine manifests in daily life and visual culture. Created in collaboration with conservationists from Bengaluru, this exhibition offers insights into faith and art.

events.title: Precious — Free Exhibition
events.description: Discover a unique free exhibition at the Museum of Brisbane, showcasing over 3,000 items from 30 private collections, many displayed for the first time. This treasure trove offers a glimpse into the diverse passions and stories of Brisbane's collectors.

events.title: A Conversation with Jefferson Fisher
events.description: Join lawyer and communicator Jefferson Fisher for an insightful conversation on human communication, confidence, and psychology. Known for his accessible insights, this event offers a chance to engage with complex topics.

events.title: ASPG-Q: AI in Parliament – Risks, Opportunities and What's Next?
events.description: A panel discussion exploring the impact of artificial intelligence on parliamentary governance, discussing both risks and opportunities. This event is ideal for those interested in AI, public policy, and the future of technology in government.

events.title: Build with AI 4.0 2026 – GDG Brisbane
events.description: Join Google Developer Group Brisbane for a community-driven, hands-on AI build event, where developers and curious tech thinkers can learn and experiment with AI tools together. Expect collaborative learning and practical application.

events.title: EmAGN Value Talk: Living Legacy of the Queensland Cultural Precinct
events.description: An architectural and cultural talk exploring the enduring legacy and future potential of Brisbane's iconic cultural precinct. This event is perfect for enthusiasts of design, history, and urban cultural development.

events.title: The Future of Heritage: Looking Back to Move Forward
events.description: A conference or talk focused on heritage preservation, examining how historical knowledge and past decisions inform contemporary design and urban planning. Ideal for those interested in history, architecture, and sustainable development.

events.title: The Explainer Series: First Nations Astronomy
events.datetime: This week July 2026 (check listing for exact date/time)
events.description: An engaging talk delving into Indigenous astronomical knowledge systems, including sky stories and the scientific insights embedded in First Nations culture. Discover the deep connections between ancient wisdom and celestial observations.

events.title: Bastille Day BBQ — Le 14 Juillet à Brisbane!
events.description: Celebrate Bastille Day at a festive French cultural BBQ, offering a lively social gathering for francophiles, expats, and anyone interested in community-led cultural events. Expect a vibrant atmosphere.

events.title: Full Flower Moon Band — Open Season @ The Tivoli
events.description: Catch Full Flower Moon Band live as part of Open Season, Brisbane's winter music program showcasing over 100 artists across various venues. Experience an intimate gig at The Tivoli, known for its strong atmosphere.

events.title: The King of Pop Show: Michael Jackson Live Concert Experience
events.description: Experience a high-energy live tribute concert bringing Michael Jackson's iconic music to life with full staging and theatrical performance. This event promises a dynamic and entertaining musical journey.

events.title: House Blend: Jazz & Deep House Experience by Nouvelle Nights
events.description: An intimate and atmospheric jazz and deep house fusion event curated by Nouvelle Nights, designed to attract a creative and culturally curious audience. Expect a unique blend of musical styles in a sophisticated setting.

events.title: Brisbane Gin Festival
events.description: Sample a variety of craft gins from over 40 Aussie distillers, chat with them about their making process, and purchase bottles to take home at this interactive 18+ festival. Your ticket includes unlimited samples and a tasting glass.
